steps.text: Talk to Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower to start the quest.
Open your Quest Journal to sync your current state.
Go through the south east door and pick up the red cog.
Use the red cog on the red spindle.

Get the bucket next to Brother Cedric, north of the monastery, and fill it up on the well next to it for the Black cog step. If you have other plans for the black cog, you can ignore this step by going down the nearby ladder.

Get the bucket next to Brother Cedric, north of the monastery, and fill it up on the well next to it for the Black cog step. If you have other plans for the black cog, you can ignore this step by going down the nearby ladder.
Follow the tunnel and push the wall at the end.
Pick up the blue cog.
Use the blue cog on the blue spindle.
Enter the north east door, and pick up the black cog with a bucket of water, alternatively you can equip ice gloves or smith gloves(i).

items.name: Bucket of Water or a pair of ice gloves or smiths gloves(i)

steps.text: Go through the north-western door.
Pick up the rat poison in the north west of the dungeon.
Pull the marked lever up.
Use the rat poison on the food trough. Wait till the rats have died.
Go through the gate.
Pick up the white cog.
Head up the ladder.
Enter the Clock Tower basement for the red cog.
Climb down the ladder to the east of the Clock Tower, next to Brother Cedric.
Enter the Clock Tower basement for the white cog.
Enter the Clock Tower basement for the black cog.

items.name: Bucket of Water or a pair of ice gloves or smiths gloves(i)

steps.text: Place the blue cog on the peg on the first floor.
Place the black cog on the peg in the basement.
Place the white cog on the peg on the second floor.
